# P04 · Practice Class engine and calls 1–3 (text) — tasks

**Goal (3 lines):** A complete text rehearsal: teacher line → labeller (call 2) → engine updates the children → child voice (call 1) → gates → reply; at session end the feedback card (call 3).
Reproducible (seeded), testable, injection-resistant; every number in a child's words is made by code.
Gate 1: a full SUB-SFL rehearsal runs end to end in text, in recorded mode and once live.

**Read:** BUILD_PROMPTS P04; design §Practice Class, §AI layer rows 1–3, §Specific risks; CLAUDE.md §5.

**Starting commit:** `6b18369` · **Started:** 2026-10-17

## Tasks

- [x] **T01 · Content schemas, loaders, seed content** — test: `tests/practice/test_content.py` (every file validates; JSON Schema exported; 10+ personas per language, balanced).
- [x] **T02 · Simulator core: state, apply_move, plan_turn, is_finished** — tests: determinism by seed, move effects exactly as configured, end conditions, shy child, scolding, posed problem through the bug function, numbers always from the engine.
- [x] **T03 · Reasoning steps and seat filling** — tests: SUB-SFL 52−29 gives "9 minus 2 is 7; 5 minus 2 is 3"; seat mix follows class counts.
- [x] **T04 · Call 2 labeller (prompt v2, schema, guards, injection override)** — tests: label set enforced, low confidence → other, injection → off_task, bad posed problem falls back.
- [x] **T05 · Call 1 child voice (prompt v2, validators, template fallback)** — tests: wrong number and number words rejected, template after second failure.
- [x] **T06 · Call 3 feedback (prompt v2, validators)** — tests: invented quote rejected, rubric points only, no scores, scolding named gently.
- [x] **T07 · Session orchestration with `layers` trace** — tests: full scripted session, 40-turn cap, material taps.
- [x] **T08 · API: sessions, turns, end** — contract tests in recorded and stub mode.
- [x] **T09 · Practice CLI and stub client** — test: CLI runs a SUB-SFL session offline.
- [x] **T10 · Eval 2 runner (simulator fidelity) + 10 injection seeds in the red team** — `tests/evals/test_sim_fidelity.py`.
- [x] **T11 · Recorded end-to-end session, live session, live fidelity ≥ 50 turns, latency** — acceptance evidence.
- [x] **T12 · Docs `docs/practice-class.md`, reviews, report** — acceptance table below.

Evidence for every task: commits `3a82c5d`..`7fb53aa` and the report `docs/build/reports/P04-practice-class-engine.md`; `python tasks.py check` green (485 tests).

## Acceptance criteria (copied from BUILD_PROMPTS.md)

| Criterion | Proof (command or test) | Result | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A full SUB-SFL session in English runs end to end via the CLI and the API in recorded mode, and once live (cost and latency logged), ending in a feedback card with two verbatim quotes | `tests/practice/test_recorded_session.py`; `docs/evidence/practice_session_live.json` | recorded in library, API, CLI; one live session with card and two verbatim quotes | ✅ |

| Median text-turn latency measured against < 3 s; if over, the report states the plan | `evals/results/practice_latency.json` | median 4968 ms, over the 3000 ms target; plan in the report | ❌ plan stated |
